population.kidComparison: Over 215 million people live here—nearly half of all people in South America!

geography.climate: Mostly tropical and warm year-round, with lush rainforests in the north and cooler subtropical weather in the far south.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: A green background with a large yellow diamond in the center holding a blue globe studded with 27 white stars.

anthem.title: Hino Nacional Brasileiro
anthem.summary: Celebrates Brazil's rivers, forests, and sunny skies.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Amazon River carries more water than the next seven largest rivers in the world combined.
